query: SELECT u.id, u.openId, u.name, m.id as membership_id, m.role, t.id as tenant_id, t.name as tenant_name FROM users u LEFT JOIN memberships m ON u.id = m.userId LEFT JOIN tenants t ON m.tenantId = t.id LIMIT 10;
